launch_on_login.label: Launch on login
launch_on_login.description: Start Utterbar automatically when you sign in to Windows, so the floating bar is always there without opening it manually.

start_minimised.label: Start minimised
start_minimised.description: When on, Utterbar launches straight to the tray and the floating bar, no main window until you ask for it. When off, the Dashboard opens on launch so you see your stats immediately.

close_to_tray.label: Close to tray
close_to_tray.description: Pressing the X on any window hides it to the tray instead of quitting.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Background palette for the main window and onboarding.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The colour used for the recording button, the pill glyph, highlights, and the floating bar's waveform.

custom_accent.title_free: Custom accent is a Pro feature

app_language.label: App language
app_language.description: Interface language. Dictation language is set separately in Models.

sound_cues.label: Sound cues
sound_cues.description: Play a short synthesised tone when recording starts, stops, succeeds, or errors. The tones are generated in-app via WebAudio so there are no sample files, low-volume by default.

sound_profile.label: Sound profile
sound_profile.description: Which family of cue tones to use. Click a profile to hear its success cue.

default.label: Default
default.description: Warm triangle tones on a musical fifth — the soft, satisfying default.

classic.label: Tactile
classic.description: Crisp mechanical clicks on start / stop, a soft bell on success.

subtle.label: Subtle
subtle.description: Quiet single-tone blips — minimal, no melody.

chime.label: Chime
chime.description: Warm triangle-wave thirds with longer decay.

notifications.label: System notifications
notifications.description: Raise a Windows toast when something actually needs your attention, dictation errors, model-install failures, successful model installs.

custom_accent.description: Pick any colour for the accent family, the recording button, the floating bar's waveform, the pill glyph, and every highlight. The six presets are free; bring-your-own is part of Pro.

bullets.any_hex: Pick any hex colour from the native Windows colour picker
bullets.auto_tint_shade: Auto-derived tint and shade so gradients still have depth
bullets.presets_free: All six preset accents stay free for everyone

matches.type_out_if_blocked: Type it out if paste is blocked

text_output.title: Text Output
text_output.subtitle: How dictated text reaches your active app.

paste_automatically.label: Paste automatically
paste_automatically.description: After transcription, copy the result to the clipboard and simulate Ctrl+V. This is the fastest, most reliable path, most apps accept it.

restore_clipboard.label: Restore previous clipboard
restore_clipboard.description: About 1.5 seconds after pasting, put whatever was on your clipboard before back. Keeps your copy buffer intact.

keystroke_fallback.label: Type it out if paste is blocked
keystroke_fallback.description: Some apps (admin tools, remote desktop, a few games) don't accept pasted text. When that happens, Utterbar types the words in one character at a time instead. Slower, but it reaches apps that would otherwise drop the paste. Leave this on unless you've got a reason not to.

auto_capitalise.label: Auto-capitalise first letter
auto_capitalise.description: Make sure the inserted text starts with a capital letter, regardless of how the model transcribed it.

trim_trailing_space.label: Trim trailing whitespace
trim_trailing_space.description: Remove any spaces, tabs, or newlines at the end of the transcribed text before it gets inserted.

auto_space_on_paste.label: Auto-space between dictations
auto_space_on_paste.description: When you dictate two things back-to-back in the same app, add a space between them if the first one didn't already end with whitespace. Keeps 'hello' + 'world' from colliding into 'helloworld'.

numbers_as_digits.label: Numbers as digits
numbers_as_digits.description: Convert spoken numbers into digits (‘twenty three’ → ‘23’, ‘five pounds’ → ‘5 pounds’). Idioms stay as words (‘one of these days’). Turn off if you prefer numbers spelled out.

smart_rewrite.label: Smart rewrite
smart_rewrite.description: Clean up fillers (‘um’, ‘uh’, ‘like’), spacing, capitalisation, and terminal punctuation locally before insertion. Deterministic only — no AI model, no cloud service, no model download. Adds a small amount of processing time. Off by default. Best for chat and email-style dictation; turn off if you dictate code (the rule that capitalises sentence starts will also capitalise keywords like ‘let’ or ‘fn’). Meeting Mode is unaffected (transcripts stay verbatim).

shift_to_auto_send.label: Hold Shift to auto-send
shift_to_auto_send.description: If you're holding Shift when you stop recording, Utterbar presses Enter for you right after pasting, so the message goes out in Teams, Slack, Discord, etc. without a second hand-off.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.subtitle: Make Utterbar's main window more comfortable to read, hear, and move through.

ui_scale.title: UI scale
ui_scale.description: Scales the entire main window, text, padding, buttons, and icons, relative to the default. The floating bar is deliberately exempt so it stays the same physical size whatever you pick here.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Pick a preset or drag the slider for fine control.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: For anyone who finds bouncy animations distracting or vertigo-inducing.

reduce_motion.label: Reduce motion
reduce_motion.description: Minimise animations across Utterbar, the floating bar still appears, but the bouncy springs, bar-expand transitions, and launch pulse are suppressed. Framer Motion and CSS transitions both honour this.

contrast.title: Contrast and focus
contrast.description: Raise the visibility of text, borders, and keyboard focus. Useful for low-vision users and bright-room work.

high_contrast.label: High contrast
high_contrast.description: Push dim greys toward full white (or full black on Paper), thicken hairline separators, and bump every border token to its stronger variant. Applies everywhere, main window, floating bar, onboarding.

larger_focus_rings.label: Larger focus rings
larger_focus_rings.description: Thicken keyboard focus outlines from 2px to 4px with a stronger halo, so tab-navigated focus is unmistakable on any background. Mouse-driven focus is unaffected.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Windows and sticky headers use subtle backdrop-blur by default. Turn it off if it makes content hard to read, or if your GPU is working hard on other things.

reduce_transparency.label: Reduce transparency
reduce_transparency.description: Solidify any glass / frosted backgrounds and strip backdrop-blur throughout the app. Doesn't change layout, just the visual feel of headers and overlays.

bar_settings.title: Utterbar
bar_settings.subtitle: The floating pill that lives on top of your desktop. Tune what it looks like and when it shows up.

always.label: Always visible
always.description: The Utterbar sits at the top of your screen whenever the app is running. Default behaviour — easiest to spot, easiest to click.

while_recording.label: Only while recording
while_recording.description: The bar stays hidden until you trigger dictation, then pops in so you can see the waveform and stop / cancel. Minimal on-screen footprint.

hidden.label: Never show
hidden.description: The Utterbar never appears. Drive everything from your keyboard shortcut and the tray icon. The fastest, quietest setup.

size.label: Size
size.description: Compact shrinks the pill footprint. Standard gives its controls more breathing room.

outline.label: Accent outline
outline.description: Adds a thin accent-coloured border around the pill so it's easier to pick out against bright wallpapers and light backgrounds.

reset.label: Reset position
reset.description: Snap the Utterbar back to the top-centre of your current monitor. Use this if the pill has ended up behind the taskbar, off-screen, or on a monitor you've since unplugged. Also available from the tray icon's right-click menu.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Local-only dictation for Windows. All audio and text processing is performed on this machine. No cloud services are contacted for transcription or post-processing.

third_party.title: Third-party licences
third_party.description: Open-source libraries and models bundled with Utterbar.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Global keybindings. Press any key combination in any app to trigger.

audio.title: Audio
audio.subtitle: Input devices, preprocessing, and mic testing.

capture_source.title: Capture source
capture_source.description: What Utterbar listens to. Switch to System audio to transcribe a meeting or a video playing in another app; Mixed records both so a call where you also speak gets both sides.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.note: Record your voice from the selected microphone. Best for everyday dictation.

system.label: System audio
system.note: Record whatever is playing through your speakers, meetings, videos, voice notes. WASAPI loopback: no virtual cable needed.

mixed.label: Mixed (mic + system)
mixed.note: Both at once, summed. Useful for transcribing calls where you also speak.

meeting_callout.title: Heads up: Meeting Mode handles this for you
meeting_callout.description: When a mode is flagged as a Meeting, Utterbar always uses mic + system audio together (no need to set it here), splits long recordings into 30-second chunks so they don't OOM the recogniser, and skips post-processing so the transcript stays verbatim. The built-in 'Meeting' mode is set up that way out of the box.

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.description: Which device Utterbar records from. System default follows whatever Windows has set.

noise_handling.title: Noise handling
noise_handling.description: Clean up the recording before it reaches Parakeet. Everything here runs locally in sub-millisecond time, there's no cloud pass.

suppression.label: Suppression strength
suppression.description: Broadband filter that kills rumble, fan hum, and HVAC noise. Start with Balanced; step up to Aggressive only if there's still a lot of room noise in the background.
suppression.preview_hint: Tap any level to hear a ~1 s sample.

off.label: Off
off.blurb: No processing. Lowest latency, keeps every nuance for the model.

light.label: Light
light.blurb: Trim subwoofer-band rumble (under ~60 Hz). Good for quiet rooms.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.blurb: Cuts fan hum, HVAC, and keyboard clatter between words. Best for most setups.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.blurb: Harder high-pass + higher gate. For cafés and noisy rooms; can clip soft consonants.

noise_gate.label: Between-word gate
noise_gate.description: Zero out short quiet gaps so keyboard clicks, mouse-clicks, lip-smacks, and breath sounds between phrases don't reach the model. Complements the suppression above, safe to use at any level.

dynamic_normalisation.label: Dynamic normalisation
dynamic_normalisation.description: Boost quiet recordings to a consistent level before transcription. Helps when the microphone is far or the speaker is soft.

silence_removal.label: Silence trimming
silence_removal.description: Drop silent leading / trailing audio before the model sees it. Faster transcriptions, identical quality.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Utterbar processes everything on-device. You are always in control of what is retained and what is used as context.
privacy.managed_hint: Some privacy controls on this device are managed by your administrator. Restart Utterbar to pick up policy changes.

context.title: Context capture
context.description: Which signals may a mode use to tailor its output?

selection.label: Allow selection context
selection.description: Currently selected text in the foreground app.

save_recordings.label: Save recordings
save_recordings.description: Keep the WAV of each dictation on disk so you can re-play or re-transcribe it later. Files live under your Recordings folder and are automatically pruned after the retention window below.

pro_nudge.description: Keep a local WAV of every dictation so you can re-listen or re-transcribe it later. Stored on your disk only, never uploaded.

delete_after.label: Delete recordings after
delete_after.description: Older WAVs are cleaned up automatically on each new dictation, so the recordings folder doesn't balloon.

pause_music.label: Pause music while recording
pause_music.description: Automatically pause Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music, and any other app registered with Windows media controls while you dictate. Only the sessions Utterbar paused get resumed.

mute_conferencing.label: Mute conferencing app output while recording
mute_conferencing.description: Silences what you HEAR from Teams, Slack, Discord, Zoom, and Webex while you're dictating, so call audio and notification dings don't bleed into the room. Restored the moment dictation ends. This does NOT mute your microphone inside those apps, use each app's own mute button for that.

conferencing_apps.title: Apps to silence
conferencing_apps.description_prefix: Executable names matched case-insensitively against running processes.
conferencing_apps.edit_locked: Turn the toggle on above to edit this list.

errors.invalid_characters: Only letters, numbers, dot, underscore, and dash. No paths, drive letters, quotes, or wildcards.
errors.duplicate: That app is already in the list.
errors.defaults_loading: Defaults are still loading — try again in a moment.
